snippet.title: Life of a Dispatch English Teacher in Japan - FIRST TRAILER! 📏
snippet.description:
Wishlist here! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3554600/

A visual novel about living through a sudden and chaotic job loss, and making tough choices about your future. Based on the real-life experiences of foreign teachers living in Japan.

Character art by sutemo

[Music used in this video]
Hush Hamlet
https://zanelittle.bandcamp.com
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/
